content.markdown:
This Library records the observed read contract of SNL-Doc-Extension at baseline `12a9377c46966ffdf88b50793bd09d01011a65dc`. Its normative scope is the behavior of the named Extension reader APIs, not a generic SNL ideal.

Every MUST below describes a current acceptance or rejection boundary. Tolerant behavior and omitted checks are stated explicitly so a later Extension–Toolkit comparison cannot silently upgrade them into guarantees. A behavior change MUST update this Library and its conformance fixtures in the same change.
